text:
Nadia (People Ops): New micro-kit for goal setting + feedback — tiny copyable pieces for calendars, self-reviews, and async peer asks. Posting the short versions so teams actually use them.
Owen (Eng Manager): can you give me a one-line calendar description I can paste into recurring invites?
Nadia (People Ops): Calendar blurb: 'Mid-cycle check: 20m to share progress, call out one blocker, and agree 1 concrete support action.'
Pri (SWE): ok nice. what's a 2-sentence self-review ICs can paste verbatim?
Nadia (People Ops): 2-sentence self-review (copy/paste):
"Role & scope: [one line]. Core impact this cycle: [one sentence with metric or link]."
Maya (PM): any short manager 1:1 agenda we can use during the check?
Nadia (People Ops): 4-item 20m agenda:
- 3m: headline progress (impact metric or link)
- 7m: blocker(s) & context
- 7m: manager commits / decisions needed
- 3m: career pulse / next step
Owen (Eng Manager): good. calibration scoring — short form?
Nadia (People Ops): Calibration shorthand (1-line per person): Impact 1-5, Ownership 1-5, Growth 1-5. Add 1 short evidence link.
Pri (SWE): can you show a filled example quick?
Nadia (People Ops): Example (one line each):
Pri — Impact 4 (reduced tail latency 30%, dashboard), Ownership 5 (led rollout), Growth 3 (needs broader system design exposure)
Maya (PM): managers asking for peer input — simplest async prompt?
Nadia (People Ops): Async peer ask (single prompt): "In 1-2 bullets, what's one thing they did that helped your work and one thing to improve?" 48h turnaround suggested.
Owen (Eng Manager): upward feedback from reports — short phrasing?
Nadia (People Ops): Upward ask (one-liner to send): "Please give 2 bullets: 1) Stop/Start/Continue suggestion; 2) One thing I can remove as a blocker this sprint."
Pri (SWE): any guidance for variance in format (paragraph vs bullets)?
Nadia (People Ops): Note format preference in the review header (e.g., "pref: bullets"). That tells calibrators how to interpret length.
PulseBot: Tip: schedule midpoint reminders with `/perf reminder add --when 2w-before-midpoint --team @team-name`. Docs: /docs/performance/reminders
Maya (PM): version tag? we should track edits across teams.
Nadia (People Ops): version v2.0-compact. If you adapt, post tag + 1-line summary here so we keep the canonical doc updated.
Owen (Eng Manager): will adapt for on-call folks (will post v2.0-oncall).
Nadia (People Ops): quick ask — if you translate wording for other locales, include original + localized copy in the thread for audits. Thanks! :sparkles:
